findings.summary: U2 pin SCL (I2C_SCL) missing pull-up resistor
findings.description: Pin SCL on U2 (ADS112C04) is connected to net I2C_SCL but has no pull-up resistor. This pin type typically requires an external pull-up to a power rail for correct operation.
findings.recommendation: Add a 4.7k-10k pull-up resistor from I2C_SCL to the appropriate power rail.

fix_params.basis: Pin SCL is open-drain/input type requiring pull-up

report_context.impact: Pin may float or bus may not function without pull-up
